uid.description: Unique identifier of the DDA boleto (UUID). Use this value to query, release, or reject the boleto via API.

status.description: Internal status of the DDA boleto on the Kobana platform. Represents the client approval flow: `pending` (available for action: release or reject), `released` (released by client for payment — field `released_at` filled), `rejected` (rejected by client — irreversible transition — field `rejected_at` filled), `paid` (paid via Kobana — field `payment_uid` filled).

external_status.description: External status of the boleto informed by the provider. Completely independent of the `status` field and can change at any time via synchronization. `open` (open, available for payment), `overdue` (overdue — interest and penalties may apply), `paid` (paid confirmed by bank — may occur before or independent of `status: paid`), `canceled` (canceled by beneficiary or bank), `downloaded` (downloaded — equivalent to paid for internal processing purposes), `blocked` (blocked — the boleto was created but is not yet available for payment).

barcode.description: Barcode of the boleto (44 digits). Can be null when the boleto is still in initial synchronization phase.

line.description: Typable line of the boleto — formatted representation of the barcode for manual entry. Can be null during initial synchronization.

our_number.description: Our number assigned by the issuing bank. Unique identifier of the boleto in the beneficiary's banking system.

description.description: Description or instructions of the boleto informed by the beneficiary (cedent).

nominal_amount.description: Original (face) value of the boleto in reais (BRL), without surcharges or discounts. May differ from `amount` after maturity when interest/penalties are applied.

amount.description: Updated value of the boleto in reais (BRL), already considering applicable interest, penalties, discounts, and allowances. May differ from `nominal_amount` after maturity.

min_payment_amount.description: Minimum amount accepted for boleto payment in reais (BRL). Relevant when `allow_parcial_payment` is `true`.

max_payment_amount.description: Maximum amount accepted for boleto payment in reais (BRL).

expire_at.description: Boleto maturity date (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD). After this date, interest and penalties may apply as configured by the beneficiary.

issue_date.description: Boleto issuance date by the beneficiary (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD).

reference_month.description: Reference/competency month of the boleto (e.g.: month of the charged service). Values in English.

beneficiary_name.description: Name or legal name of the beneficiary (cedent) — company or person who issued the boleto and will receive payment.

beneficiary_cnpj_cpf.description: CPF or CNPJ of the beneficiary (cedent).

beneficiary_bank_name.description: Name of the bank where the beneficiary has an account for receiving.

beneficiary_bank_number.description: COMPE code (3 digits) of the beneficiary's bank. Ex: `001` (Banco do Brasil), `341` (Itaú), `237` (Bradesco).

owner_cnpj_cpf.description: CPF or CNPJ of the payer (drawee). Corresponds to the CNPJ/CPF registered in the DDA account.

owner_person_name.description: Name or legal name of the payer (drawee) — company or person in whose name the boleto was issued.

fine_amount.description: Fixed amount of late penalty in reais (BRL). Applicable after `fine_date`.

fine_percentage.description: Percentage of late penalty on the boleto value. Applicable after `fine_date`.

fine_date.description: Date from which the late penalty starts to be charged (ISO 8601 format).

interest_amount.description: Fixed amount of interest per day late in reais (BRL). Applicable after `interest_date`.

interest_percentage.description: Percentage of interest per day/month late. Applicable after `interest_date`.

interest_date.description: Date from which late interest starts to accrue (ISO 8601 format).

discount_amount.description: Fixed discount amount for early payment in reais (BRL). Valid until `discount_date`.

discount_date.description: Deadline to obtain the early payment discount (ISO 8601 format). After this date, the discount does not apply.

reduction_amount.description: Value of the allowance granted by the beneficiary in reais (BRL). Different from discount, allowance reduces the total amount regardless of payment date.

allow_parcial_payment.description: Indicates whether the boleto accepts partial payment (value less than total). When `true`, payment can be made with a value between `min_payment_amount` and `max_payment_amount`.

released_at.description: Date and time (ISO 8601) when the boleto was released for payment by the client. Filled only when `status` is `released` or `paid`.

rejected_at.description: Date and time (ISO 8601) when the boleto was rejected by the client. Filled only when `status` is `rejected`.

payment_uid.description: UUID of the Kobana payment linked to this DDA boleto. Allows tracking the payment originated from this boleto. Filled when the boleto is associated with a payment via API.

dda_account_uid.description: UUID of the DDA account (Dda::Account) that originated this boleto. Allows assigning each boleto to its DDA account when the macro account has multiple DDA accounts (distinct CNPJs). Null for legacy records not yet backfilled.

created_at.description: Date and time (ISO 8601) when the DDA boleto was received and registered on the Kobana platform.

updated_at.description: Date and time (ISO 8601) of the last update of this boleto (status change, data synchronization, etc.).
